_note: Sample scenario in the Scenario Generator output format, for demos and tests. acrKeyFindings is an optional extra the generator does not produce.
title: Skipped Lunch
scenarioIntro: 58-year-old woman with type 1 diabetes, confused and diaphoretic after skipping lunch. Cannot swallow safely. Glucagon IM, recovers, then refuses transport. Tests capacity assessment and refusal documentation.

patientDemographics.name: Joanne Martel
patientDemographics.appearance: Seated at the kitchen table, pale and sweaty, confused.

patientPresentation: Eyes open, confused to time and place, follows simple commands slowly, diaphoretic.
incidentNarrative: Took usual insulin at 0730, skipped lunch while gardening. Husband found her confused at 1245. Husband tried juice; she held it in her mouth and coughed.

physicalExam.headNeck: No head injury, no tongue bite.

withProperTreatment: Glucagon 1 mg IM: At 7 minutes talking more; at 13 minutes GCS 15, glucose 5.9.
withIncorrectTreatment: Transport offered: Patient refuses: skipped lunch, doesn't want to wait in emerg. Husband home all evening.

expectedTreatment: Glucagon 1 mg IM (unable to swallow safely)
Repeat glucose after treatment and after eating
Refusal documented with risks explained, patient's plan, responsible adult and callback advice
protocolNotes: BLS PCS refusal of service and capacity
learningObjectives: Treat hypoglycemia by route appropriate to airway protection

acrKeyFindings.finding: patient's own words for the refusal
